name: Coastless
description:
About This Game

Survive aboard a makeshift raft in a world consumed by black waters. Catch fish, explore procedurally generated islands, gather resources, and feed a mysterious monster capable of powering your raft. Cleanse the ocean and reclaim a world that has all but disappeared.

The world is drowning in thick black waters.

Only scattered islands, scarce resources, and your battered old raft remain in the endless ocean. To survive and uncover what happened, you must embark on a dangerous journey into the unknown.

Catch fish, cook food, and carefully manage your supplies. Set foot on procedurally generated islands, chop down trees, break rocks, and collect materials to craft new tools. Expand your raft, build useful workstations, and transform a fragile wooden platform into a true floating home.

But the raft cannot travel far on its own.

A mysterious monster lives beside you. Keep it fed, and in return, it will generate the energy needed to move your raft forward. Install a steering wheel, raise the sails, and chart your own course across uncharted waters.

Survive the Night

Explore islands and prepare for the journey during the day. At night, conserve your resources and stay alert for the dangers lurking in the darkness.

Features

  • Raft-based survival in a dark, flooded world.

  • Build and gradually expand your floating base.

  • Fish, cook meals, and craft tools and equipment.

  • Explore a procedurally generated world filled with islands and resources.

  • Adapt to a dynamic day-and-night cycle that affects exploration and survival.

  • Feed a mysterious monster to generate energy for your raft.

  • Install a steering wheel and sails to navigate the open waters.

  • Cleanse the black waters and restore the disappearing world.

Build. Explore. Feed the monster. And do not let the black waters consume what little remains.
short_desc: Survival crafting game: build your raft, explore procedurally generated islands, feed the monster that powers your ship, and clean the black waters to expand and save the world. Solo or co-op.
